metadata.title: Living the Sino-US Neo-Lab Capital Wave with Tsinghua's Liu Ziming: AI for AI, Mechanistic Interpretability, and Max Tegmark
metadata.guest_role: Assistant Professor, Tsinghua AI School · PI, Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute · Co-founder, Yuanhuan Intelligence

conclusion: After European/US neo-lab guests, Zhang turns to China's 2026 lab-startup mania: young elite researchers raising multi-hundred-million valuations before product, clustered on world models and Auto Research (AI for AI). Tsinghua's Liu Ziming (PKU+MIT; returned March; co-founding Yuanhuan Intelligence) calls the primary market 'too crazy' — dense information and fast checks. He maps AI science to Tycho→Kepler→Newton (roughly stage 0.5–1.5: scaling laws exist, no Newton yet) and bets mechanistic interpretability plus AI for AI — end-to-end design/train/deploy so non-experts can spawn vertical 'mini-OpenAIs'.
background:
Liu Ziming: PKU and MIT, interpretability lineage; returned China March 2026, joined Tsinghua AI School late April, began fundraising late May while co-creating Yuanhuan Intelligence; also PI at Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute. MIT felt academic-conservative; Stanford nudged the founder impulse.

The show contrasts prior New Lab interviews abroad with China's isomorphic boom — capital hottest on world models and Auto Research (AI4AI).
important_facts: Capital wave: research-background faculty/students become VC darlings — young, elite schools, first startups, multi-hundred-million USD valuations pre-product; clusters on world models, embodiment, AI for AI. Liu's feel: embodied/world-model/AI4AI primary markets are intensely 'subject-driven' with rapid mutual intel and term sheets.

Science ladder: astronomy analogy — Tycho data tables → Kepler empirical laws (scaling laws similar) → Newton unified formulas. Liu places AI at ~1.5 or a gloomier 0.5: over-focus on Transformer-like architectures is staring at one patch of sky; full-sky data exploration is incomplete.

Product bet (AI for AI): user states need + budget (e.g. $100) and the system designs, trains, deploys — vibe-coding for model R&D, democratizing training beyond a few closed giants to incubate vertical models; mechanistic interpretability and symbolic compression are the academic spine.

mental_model.name: Neo-Lab Mania × Scientific Compression Ladder × AI-for-AI Democratization
mental_model.components: Separate fundraising heat from research agenda. Use Tycho–Kepler–Newton to score field maturity; resist premature architecture lock-in. Automate research/training so model power diffuses into verticals.
mental_model.application: Diligence China lab startups on verifiable compression paths (interpretability, Auto Research), not valuation theater. Compute names still benefit if 'everyone trains models,' but near-term foam risk is pre-product mega-rounds. Split world-model hype from infra that truly lowers training barriers.

key_insights.view: China's neo-lab capital wave is 'too crazy.'
key_insights.question: What is the phenomenon?
key_insights.answer: Elite first-time founders raise huge pre-product rounds; world models and AI for AI are the hottest pockets. Primary-market information density and decision speed are extreme.

key_insights.view: AI is nowhere near its Newton stage.
key_insights.question: Why interpretability and compression?
key_insights.answer: Scaling laws are scarce Kepler-like empirics; over-indexing on Transformers leaves the full sky unexplored. Symbols/mechanistic interpretability push empirical AI toward theoretical science.

key_insights.view: AI for AI lets everyone train vertical models.
key_insights.question: What is Yuanhuan betting?
key_insights.answer: Not another closed giant — end-to-end 'train to my brief and budget,' moving vibe-coding logic onto model R&D to incubate industry mini-OpenAIs.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Liu's AI-for-AI / auto-training startup bet on lowering vertical-model barriers — early in a frothy raise cycle; low confidence
If AI for AI spreads training demand beyond frontier labs into verticals, train/infer FLOPs widen — NVDA remains the liquid proxy

golden_quotes: As long as you can do AI for AI, that's enough.
We are still far from AI's Newton stage.
